name: creality-x2000e
description: Ingenic X2000E (V12) with in-package Winbond W97BV6MK LPDDR2, as on the Creality K1 / K1 Max. For use with the k1-debian burner_x2000 (x2000_v12) SPL. Other X2000E Creality boards (K1C pre-2025, Nebula Pad) are expected to match but are UNVERIFIED.
notes: 500 MHz = MPLL 1500 MHz / 3: the DDR clock k1-debian's burner_x2000 SPL and crealityk1 U-Boot use.
Timings: Ingenic's open W97BV6MK table (golden-tested against the C creator).
ODT/auto-self-refresh off and ACTPD on, as in the header Ingenic's cloner sends (hardware-proven via ballaswag's spl.bin).
